(VI)--a son of Savana of पुष्करद्वीप; the kingdom bore his name. Vi.
--a son of अमर्षण and father of विश्व- साह्वन्. भा. IX. १२. 7.
(I)--a son of गुहावस, the अवतार् of the १७थ् dva1para. वा. २३. १७७.

(II)--a गणेश्वर; an attendant of शिव; with महाकालि engaged in the service of ललिता as one of her guardsmen; he is served by servants like कालमृत्यु; in charge of the first entrance to श्रीपुरम्; other शक्तिस् attach- ed to him are महासन्ध्य and महानिशा in the त्रिकोण and five शक्तिस् on the पञ्चकोण as also those on the षोडश पत्र and नाग पत्र; his seat is कालचक्र. --a garden in the country of अवन्ती. M. १७९. 5.
(III)--came out from the wrath of शिव. वा. १०१. २९८.

--a son of विस्तृउत (Vibudha-वि। प्।, Vis- ruta, Burnouf) and father of कृतिरात. भा. IX. १३. १६-17; Vi.
(II)--one of the twenty अमिताभ gods. Br.

--the son of Nandivardhana, the last of the ten शिशुनागस् (शिशुनाभस्) who ruled for a total period of ३६२ years; had a son, महापद्म by a शूद्र woman; ruled for ४३ years, १०५० years after परीक्षित्. The latter ruined the क्षत्रिय families; contemporaneous with them were the ऐक्ष्वाकस् 24, पाञ्चालस् 25, कालकस् 24, Haihayas २४, Kalin- gas ३२, शाकस् 25, Kuravas ३६, Maithilas २८, सूरसेनस् 23, वीतिहोत्रस् 20. भा.
--a boundary hill of शाकद्वीप. भा. V. २०. २६.
--a तीर्थ sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ५३.

(III)--the son of महानन्दि by a शूद्र woman; he was the universal emperor and brought the earth under his umbrella; ruled for ८८ (२८ वि। प्।) years; from him all kings became unrighteous; he was a scourge of the क्षत्रियस्, and just like परशुराम rooted out their families; he had eight sons, सुमाल्य (सुमाती वि। प्।, Sukalpa म्। प्।) and others, all of whom ruled altogether for १०० (१२ म्। प्।) years; then a Brahmana कौटल्य म्। प्।) brought about their fall;

-१२; Br. III. ७४. १३९-42, २२८; M. २७२. १८-22; वा. ९९. ३२६-31; Vi. IV. २४. २०-3 and २६.
from परीक्षित् to महापद्म is १०५० years; from महापद्म to Puloma Andhra is ८३६ years.

--one of the eight निधिस् of Kubera. वा. ४१. १०.

--a son of विश्रवस् and पुष्पोत्कटा. वा. ७०. ४९.

--a consort of मार्ताण्ड bhairava. Br. IV. ३५. ४७.
--the great deluge with darkness per- vading all round.
--a नाग in the वैदूर्यशाला of श्रीपुरम्. Br. IV. ३३. ३६.

--the gift of a golden pitcher with gems set; the giver is absolved of the cycle of births and deaths and enjoys the world of विष्णु. M. २७४. १०; २८९. 1-१७.
--the great snake which is the Lord's bed on the dark waters. वा. २४. ११.
(I)--a son of सात्वत; a righteous King and the originator of the Bhoja tribe: a महारथ who killed Satrajit, and gave Syamantaka to अक्रूर. भा. IX. २४. 7, ११; Br. III. ७१. 2, १७-71; Vi. IV. १३. 1, 7.
--a Janapada of the भद्रा country. वा. ४३. २२.

--the worthy son of Janamejaya (महा- शाला वि। प्।, म्। प्।, and वा। प्।); according to ब्र्। प्। his father was पुरञ्जय; his sons were उशीनर and तितीक्षु: an emperor; lord of seven worlds, and a cakravarti. भा. IX. २३. 2; Br. III. ७४. १५-17; M. ४८. १४-15; वा. ९९. १६-8; Vi. IV. १८. 7-8.
--a दानव and a commander of भण्ड. Br.
--a विद्या taught to Pradyumna by माया- वती to vanquish शम्बर; it was an अस्त्र and one which could dispel all माया। भा. X. ५५. १६, २२.
--served by a number of Rudras: the presiding deity of the चक्र। Br. IV. ४२. 2.
--a Mt. south of the मानस. वा. ३६. २४.
--a राक्षस having his city in the fifth talam (महातलम्, वा। प्।). Br. II. २०. ३७; वा. ५०. ३६.

--five in number: could be done by शूद्रस् without मन्त्रस्; fruitful in several ways; one failing to do them becomes indebted; the oblation to be offered in the North-east; first the offering of पिण्ड and then the [page२-662+ २९] feeding of guests; Dharmic guests not to be sent away and useless ones fed. Br. III. १२. १६-20; वा. ७६. १७, २६, ३०.
--a son of सङ्कृति; married सत्कृती and had two sons, Gurudhi and Rantideva. M. ४९. ३६-7.

--a title earned by the five sons of कार्त- वीर्यार्जुन;
1: Br. III. ६९. ४९; वा. ९२. ७०.
an epithet of a राक्षस in the army of भण्ड.
2: Br. IV. २९. २१.
--a मन्त्र: sacred to the पिट्र्स्: an epithet of शिव. M. २२. ३४; Br. IV. ३३. ८४; ३४. 1, ५०-1.
--a son of कृतिरात (कीर्तिराज वा। and वि। प्।) and father of स्वर्णरोमन्. भा. IX. १३. १७; Br. III. ६४. १३-14; वा. ८९. १३; Vi.
--one of the २८ hells (seven hells below the earth वा। प्।); the place where a class of Rurus called क्रश्यादस् torment one, who had been selfish all along. भा. V. २६. 7, १२; वा. १०१. १७७; Vi.
(II)--a son of गुहावास of the १७थ् dva1para. वा. २३. १७७.
(II)--a name for the सिद्धक्षेत्रम्, the residence of महेश्वर; a visit to the place relieves one of his debts to ten generations above and below as well as his own self. वा. २३. १७५, १७९.
--a तीर्थ sacred to Kapila; sacred to the पिट्र्स्. M. १३. ३३; २२. ३४.
--an अक्षरादेवी: killed केकिवाहन, a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. १९. ५८; २५. ९६; ३७. ३४. [page२-664+ २६]
--an account of, in the वराह पुराण। M. ५३. ३९.

--a name of ललिता;
1: Br. IV. १८. १६.
symbolical of देवी.
2: Vi.
--one of the sons of Danu. वा. ६८. 4.
--the son of Savana and King of the महावीत Kingdom. Br. II. १४. १४-15; वा. ३३. १४.
--a Kingdom of पुष्करद्वीप; after महा- वीत, son of Savana; adjoining the मानस Mt. Br. II. १९. ११७, १२५; वा. ३३. १५; ४९. ११३, १२१.
--a son of Priyavrata, remained a bachelor all through life engaged in आत्मविद्या। भा.
--Mohini got the name from ब्रह्मा; also सावित्री. वा. २५. ५०.
--the performance of this vow leads one to the world of गौरी. M. १०१. ५३.
--a chief नाग of पाताल; a thousand hood- ed snake; presiding over the month, सह। भा. V. २४. ३१; XII. ११. ४१;
--a son of Janamejaya; a king equal to Indra in fame; father of महामनस्. M. ४८. १३; वा. ९९. १५-6; Vi. IV. १८. 6-7.
--a R. sacred to the पिट्र्स्. M. २२. ४२.
--originated from the वीर्य dropped by शिव in his embrace of मोहिणी--विष्णु. Br. IV. १०. ७५; १४. 7; ३९. ५७.
--a son of Janamejaya and father of महा- manas. भा. IX. २३. 2.
--a god of the प्रसूत group. Br. II. ३६. ७१.
--a शक्ति attached to महाकाल. Br. IV. ३२. 9. [page२-667+ २२]
--a Janapada of the भद्रा continent. वा. ४३. २०.
(I)--a son and commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८१; २६. ४७.
(II)--a son of रोहिणी and आनकदुन्दुभि. M. ४६. १२.
--the other name for the कालसूत्र hell. वा. १०१. १७८.
(II)--one of the eight योगैश्वर्यस्; the third Yoga. वा. १३. 3, १३.
(I)--a son of Bhaga and सिद्धी. भा. VI. १८. 2.
(II)--a son of आयु Agni; also शावन्. वा. २९. ३७.
(I)--a son of अनुह्राद and सूर्म्या: fought with विभावसु in the देवासुर war. भा. VI. १८. १६; VIII. १०. ३२.
(II)--the son of आयु and father of Sahasa. Br. II. १२. ४०.
(III)--a Mt. of कुशद्वीप (शाल्मलिद्वीपम् ब्र्।, वा।, and वि। प्।); here lives a fire called महिष, and born of waters. Br. II. १९. ४०-41. M. १२२. ५९-60; वा. ४९. ३७. Vi.
(IV)--the name of a water-born fire in the महिष hill of the शाल्मलिद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ४१; वा. ४९. ३७.
(VII)--the kingdom of, to be ruled over by Guha. Br. III. ७४. १९८.
